title: Birtokos személyjelek: -m, -d
summary: Hungarian says “my” and “your” with an ending: a feleség → a feleségem (my wife), a feleséged (your wife).

sections.text: Instead of a separate word, “my” is **-m** and informal “your” is **-d**, added to the noun. The article stays: **a** feleségem, **az** anyukám.
Final **a → á** and **e → é**: anyuk**a** → anyuk**á**m, iskol**a** → iskol**á**m.

items.en: compound words: the LAST word decides

items.hu: a hotel → a hotelem, a koncert → a koncertem
items.en: foreign words: the last vowel decides

items.hu: a ház → a házam, DE a szám → a számom
items.en: one-syllable words: learn them one by one

sections.text: To stress MY, add **az én**: Az **én** barátom is cseh. = MY boyfriend is Czech too.
